newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell 38 pct in KomiTEK oil firm Dec 6.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell 38 pct in KomiTEK oil firm Dec 6.

text.p: The Russian Federal Property Fund will sell 38 percent of NK KomiTEK oil group on December 6 at an investment tender, the fund said in a statement on Tuesday.
Foreign companies are not allowed to participate.
The minimum investment volume is $14 million.
The fund will auction off 63.14 million shares with a face value of 10 roubles at a starting price of 22.10 billion roubles for the whole lot or 350 roubles per share.
The funds will be used to build a 138 km oil pipeline from Kharyaga to Usinsk in northern Russia.
If the winner offers more than the minimum investment, the rest of the money will be used to pay the company's debts to the government.
At the last cash auction of KomiTEK in February three percent of KomiTEK shares were sold at 1,199.6 roubles per share.
KomiTEK's main production unit is AO Komineft.
